subject: Pilot credits & burn-rate check-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:00:00 -0000
Subject: Pilot credits & burn-rate check-in

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- What I heard: you want to validate a summarization and retrieval flow; current pilot usage ~2.5M tokens/day with spikes to ~5M on demo days. Key success metric is latency under 350ms for user-facing flows and cost <= $/1M tokens in the $700–$900 range.
- Ask from your side: an additional credit extension so your engineers can finish integration testing and load-based verification.

To move forward I need two quick confirmations from your team: 1) rough daily token burn profile for the next 30 days (avg / peak), and 2) target budget range for production (monthly). I attached the usage export from our console that shows your current pilot burn — feel free to correct if anything looks off (attachment: pilot_usage_report.csv).

If those look reasonable we can escalate a short credit extension approval (I’ll loop in billing). Proposed next step: you share the 30-day burn projection by Mon 9/13 and I’ll come back with an extension amount and timing.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: pilot_usage_report.csv (CSV, 1.2KB)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & burn-rate check-in

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers from our side:
- Current pilot: avg ~3M tokens/day, typical weekday peaks ~5M tokens, weekends drop to ~0.8–1M.
- Expected production baseline after integration: ~1M tokens/day active users, but we plan staged ramp over 60 days.
- Budget: core team is planning $3k–$6k/mo to start, with stretch to $10k/mo if unit economics hold. Our target unit cost to greenlight broader rollout is ~$800 / 1M tokens.

We do need an extension to the trial credits to finish load testing — request +30 days and enough credits to cover peak-day test runs (rough estimate: 1.5M extra tokens for each of 5 heavy test days). If you can propose a formal number we can approve internally.

Folks on our side: I’ve cc’d Sara (finance) so she’s looped on budget. Happy to jump on a quick sync early next week if needed.

—Jordan
Jordan Lee
Senior Product Manager, Acme, Inc.
jordan.lee@acme.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & burn-rate check-in

Jordan — appreciate the details. Based on your profile and target $/1M tokens, internal approvals for a short pilot extension are straightforward. Proposed approval:

- Credit extension: 1,000,000 tokens (one million tokens) for 30 days to cover your planned heavy test runs and ramp verification.
- Rationale: at your $800 target / 1M tokens this gives you a predictable window to validate unit economics and avoids billing surprises during the pilot.

Next steps:
1) Neha (cc’d) will issue the formal pilot amendment PDF and record the extension against DEAL-ACME-0091. I attached a one-page memo with the approved credit and terms (pilot-extension-approval.pdf).
2) If you need more tokens mid-run we can review a one-time top-up (requires sign-off from finance).
3) We should schedule a 30–45 minute post-load-test review after your heavy runs to walk through performance and pricing optimization (can set that up for week of 9/28).

Sara — if you need any PO or formal invoice language, loop Neha and she’ll coordinate.

Let me know if that works and I’ll have the PDF routed for signature today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: pilot-extension-approval.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

We’ll plan the follow-up review for the week of 9/28; can you send a few time options? Also copying Sara so finance has the approved amendment on file.

Thanks again,
Jordan
